usage.h1: font-headings font-black text-6xl md:text-8xl tracking-tight leading-[0.9] uppercase
usage.label: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500

rules: NO gradients for buttons or backgrounds.
Use pure black (#000000) or near-black (#050505) for backgrounds.
Use pure white (#FFFFFF) for primary text and actions.
Use greyscale for hierarchy. No colors allowed except for semantic states (Error/Success) which should be stark.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-none h-12 px-8 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-sm transition-transform active:scale-95 border border-white
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-zinc-700 hover:border-white hover:bg-zinc-900 rounded-none h-12 px-8 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-sm transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-zinc-400 hover:text-white font-mono uppercase text-xs tracking-widest hover:underline decoration-1 underline-offset-4

inputs.default: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-zinc-800 focus:border-white rounded-none px-0 py-4 text-xl font-headings placeholder:text-zinc-700 focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none transition-colors
inputs.label_behavior: Label should be uppercase, mono, and float above or sit beside the input.

cards.style: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 p-8 rounded-none hover:border-zinc-600 transition-colors relative overflow-hidden group
cards.hover_effect: Add a subtle white glow in the corner or a scanline effect on hover.

visual_enhancers.noise_texture: fixed inset-0 z-[-1] opacity-[0.03] pointer-events-none mix-blend-overlay bg-[url('https://grainy-gradients.vercel.app/noise.svg')]
visual_enhancers.scanlines: pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[linear-gradient(rgba(18,16,16,0)_50%,rgba(0,0,0,0.25)_50%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,0,0,0.06),rgba(0,255,0,0.02),rgba(0,0,255,0.06))] bg-[length:100%_2px,3px_100%] pointer-events-none opacity-20
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders. For 'Receipt' sections, use dashed borders (border-dashed).

motion.page_load: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Stroke width: 1.5px. Sharp edges if possible.

general: STRICTLY follow the Black & White theme. No colors.
Use the 'Syne' font for the 'Stashorra' logo text.
The 'Price Estimation' result should look like a printed receipt or a terminal output.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all pricing numbers and technical specs.
Inputs should feel like filling out a government form or a manifest - serious and structured.
Use the 'noise_texture' class on the main wrapper to give a film grain effect.

landing.hero: Center aligned, massive text 'WHAT IS IT WORTH?'. Minimal search bar below.
landing.features: Bento grid of features (Real-time scraping, AI Analysis, Instant Quote). Use icons.

condition_form.layout: Step-by-step wizard or a single long 'Manifest' form.
condition_form.style: Typewriter style. Questions on the left, Yes/No toggles on the right.

results.layout: Split screen. Left: Phone Image (Grayscale). Right: The 'Receipt' with the price breakdown.
results.details: Show 'Slot.com New Price' and 'Jiji.com Used Price' as reference points in mono font.

universal_guidelines: Do not use rounded corners > 4px. Prefer 0px.
Always add data-testid to interactive elements.
